scripts.build: rimraf dist && pnpm exec vite build && node scripts/patch-dist-package.mjs && node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const r = spawnSync('pnpm', ['exec', 'tsc', '-p', 'tsconfig.build.json', '--emitDeclarationOnly', '--outDir', 'dist/types'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); if (r.status) console.warn('tsc finished with errors, continue...');"
